description: This file implements the AttachSource task for a media pipeline, including classes for building media source capabilities and methods for attaching, updating, and switching media sources in a GStreamer-based media player.

classes.name: MediaSourceCapsBuilder
classes.description: Base class for building media source capabilities, including common attributes and methods for adding alignment, codec data, and stream format to GstCaps.

classes.name: MediaSourceAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building audio-specific media source capabilities, including handling Opus and MPEG audio formats.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building video-specific media source capabilities, including width and height.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoDolbyVisionCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building Dolby Vision video capabilities, including Dolby Vision profile and stream flags.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: Main class implementing the task to attach a media source to the pipeline, including methods for creating caps, adding sources, updating caps, and switching audio sources.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main logic to create caps from the media source and attach or switch the source in the pipeline.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a new media source to the pipeline by creating an appsrc element and setting its caps.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the caps of an existing appsrc element if they differ from the new caps.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Handles switching the audio source, including performing codec/channel switch via external utility.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Creates GstCaps based on the media source type, using appropriate builder classes.

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Constructs audio attributes for switching, based on the media source audio configuration.
